patch_description: The current candidate uses a fixed CZ ring (no long-range entanglement) plus pre/post RZ layers, which underperforms the earlier "crz_skip" variant that achieved 0.87 combined score. That variant used a single shared parameter for all skip-2 connections, which is very restrictive (only one trainable degree of freedom for all long-range couplings). Following the recommendation, I extend that skip-2 layer here with two alternating shared parameters (`crz_skip_even` and `crz_skip_odd`), applied alternately across edges [0,2],[1,3],[2,4],[3,5],[4,6],[5,7]. This mirrors the successful ring-alternation pattern already used effectively in the nearest-neighbor CRZ layers of the highest-scoring seed, giving the circuit more expressive long-range entanglement while keeping parameter count low (+2 params only) and preserving the tight regularization that keeps the generalization gap small. This should improve validation/test accuracy and reduce the loss compared to the current CZ-only long-range-free variant.
